description: This file is a Jinja-templated Python source code for a specialized GPU kernel within the PyTorch _inductor module. It contains code for caching, kernel building, and launching grouped GEMM (matrix multiplication) operations using cutlass libraries and custom CUDA kernels. The code references external cutlass utilities, a vendor-provided grouped GEMM implementation, and defines functions and kernels to facilitate high-performance matrix computations with specific problem configurations.

classes.name: GroupedGemmKernel
classes.description: External class imported from cutlass implementation, used for grouped GEMM operations with specific configurations.

methods.name: get_hardware_info
methods.description: Retrieves maximum active clusters on GPU hardware, cached to avoid recompilation overhead.

methods.name: get_prep_cache_key
methods.description: Constructs a cache key based on the shapes, strides, and dtypes of input tensors for preprocessing kernel caching.

methods.name: get_gemm_cache_key
methods.description: Creates a cache key for the grouped GEMM kernel based on preprocessing cache key, active clusters, and total clusters.
